title: Scan of a Unary Run
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and every binary string $r$, scanning the string consisting of $n$ consecutive $1$s followed by $r$, starting in the unary-index state, produces $n$ consecutive $1$s followed by the scan of $r$ starting in the unary-index state.
replaced:
For every $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and binary string $r$, the polarity-flipping scan from the
unary-index state of the formula syntax scanner maps $1^n \mathbin{+\!\!+} r$ to
$1^n$ followed by the polarity-flipping scan of $r$ from the unary-index state.
